plugins.Author: Faye, Kage
plugins.Name: Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface
plugins.Punchline: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
plugins.Description:
Helps with Occult Crescent (South Horn and North Horn).
- Illegal Mode: full autopilot for FATEs, Critical Encounters and Magic Pots, with treasure hunting in between
- Treasure Hunter: bronze and silver coffer routes, and Carrot Hunt
- Mob Farmer: pulls and clears packs at spots you save
- World: live FATE and CE lists with rewards; walk or teleport there
